open_admin.description: Open a shop's Medusa admin and report whether the session is authenticated (unauthenticated sessions are redirected to /app/login).

returns.description: { authenticated: boolean, url: string } — authenticated=false means the login page is showing; hand off to the user to log in once, the session persists in the profile.

whoami.description: Check the admin session from the page context. Run on any page of the admin origin.

list_orders.description: List recent orders via the admin API from the authenticated page context — no DOM scraping, no snapshot needed.

returns.description: { count: number, orders: [{ id, display_id, email, total, currency_code, payment_status, fulfillment_status, created_at }] } or { error, status } when the API rejects the call.

search_products.description: Search products by title/handle via the admin API from the authenticated page context.

query.description: Search text matched against product title and handle.

returns.description: { count: number, products: [{ id, title, handle, status, variants: number }] } or { error, status } when the API rejects the call.
